name: Renewal Countdown
description: Weekly renewal digest, as an Attention agent-builder flow: schedule -> askAttention (find 30/60/90-day renewals, grade each account's health from its calls, write the tiered digest) -> post to a channel. The @activepieces/piece-schedule cron trigger is verified against Activepieces. Confirm the askAttention context scope for a non-conversation query (contextType 'user') and the output action against your own export. Set connections and the placeholder ids (<...>) on import.

nextAction.name: analyze_renewals
nextAction.displayName: Find upcoming renewals, grade health from calls, write the digest

input.prompt: You are the Renewal Countdown agent. (1) List all accounts with contract renewal dates in the next 30, 60, and 90 days. For each, include account name, renewal date, contract value (ARR/ACV), assigned CSM/owner, and the date of the most recent call. (2) For each account, pull its calls from the last ~90 days and report total calls, average sentiment, unresolved issues/open action items, competitor or alternative mentions, expansion signals, and any dissatisfaction. Grade health: HEALTHY (3+ calls in 90 days, mostly positive, no unresolved issues, no competitor mentions), AT RISK (1-2 calls, OR mixed sentiment, OR 1+ unresolved issues), CRITICAL (0 calls, OR negative trend, OR competitor mentions, OR explicit dissatisfaction). (3) Write the digest grouped by 30-DAY (Immediate Action Required), 60-DAY (Begin Preparation), and 90-DAY (On the Radar); per account show renewal date, value, owner, health with a colored circle, recent engagement, risk factors, and prep actions sized to the health tier; end with a summary count. Handle edge cases per renewal-countdown.md (no renewals, no calls -> CRITICAL, overdue, missing value). Apply humanizer rules: no em dashes, no AI throat-clearing, no hype, one clear ask.

nextAction.name: post_digest
nextAction.displayName: Post the renewal digest to the renewals channel
